context: After the one permitted Unit 063 aggregation, the ignored one-shot Python source was deleted with apply_patch. An exact-target git-clean command was then used to remove its generated bytecode, but Git treated the ignored parent directory as the cleanup scope.
recovery: The exact deleted bytes cannot be recovered from Git. No replacement is created because the paths had no tracked/evidence reference and fabricating an alleged exact copy would be misleading.
prevention: Do not use git clean beneath an ignored parent for a single generated bytecode target; leave harmless bytecode in place when direct exact-file removal is unavailable.
